def simulate_program(n, sequence):
    results = []
    for i in range(1, n):
        x, y = 1, 0
        while True:
            x += sequence[i - 1]
            y += sequence[i - 1]
            if x <= 0 or x > n:
                results.append(-1)
                break
            y -= sequence[i - 1]
            x -= sequence[i - 1]
    return results
